contentText:
Pokémon 's 30th anniversary is here and Nintendo (and The Pokémon Company, Game Freak, and Omega Force) are kicking things off with a surprisingly excellent life simulation spinoff game. Pokémon Pokopia arrives on March 5th, and it's one of the first Pokémon titles that will debut exclusively on the Nintendo Switch 2. Equal parts Animal Crossing , Minecraft, and Dragon Quest Builders , Pokopia reimagines the Pokémon world as a massive, human-free paradise that you can rebuild however you want.
